authored_by: Claude (triage trial session), before any arm ran
purpose: Mike's direction (2026-11-17): realistic questions a sepsis readmission committee, a heart-failure program and a value-based care team ask, all answerable from EHR, claims, pharmacy and lab data; the hospital's own certified definitions only.
scoring: Proof scorecard, strict: +1 right, 0 declined, -10 wrong; cost per answer. Arms: stack (the full stack: hospital certified definitions and Agere governed definitions) and assistant (LLM alone at its best: top-tier model, SQL tool, the definitions document).
